# 2016 STRONGHOLD – hindsight

Source: user hindsight notes, batch 1 (2026-09-27).

## Game play / meta
- Overall game play: **two ball scorers**, one going through the low bar and the other through the defenses
  (obstacles). The third robot either crossed defenses and shot, or crossed defenses and then played defense.
- Elite human players could pass the ball along the floor over both alliances' defense lanes and deliver it directly
  into their own alliance zone.
- In AUTO, elite teams started with two balls, dropped one at the start of the match, and picked it up again from that known
  location on the way back.
- Many concepts were very effective, among them:
  - **1690 / 971** – collapsible low-riders that mostly used the low bar, then quickly opened their shooter to shoot
    over defense, from mid to long range.
  - **254 / 2056 / 987** – low turrets that shot from any range.
  - **1241 / 3476** – high turrets, specialized in close shots or shots adjacent to the tower.
  - **148 / 118 / 1986 / 195** – catapults.
- The climb was helpful but not critical (you could earn similar points from shooting in the same time).

## Effective mechanisms
- **148 / 118 / 1986 / 195** catapult.
- **1690** collapsible shooter.
- **254** turret.
- **118 / 3476 harpoon climber** – they "shoot" a harpoon with a rope so it hooks onto the high rung, then winch the
  rope to lift the robot.
